name: decision-tracker
description: Keeps decisions mentioned in replies in a band above the prompt until they are written to your decision log.

keywords.title: Decision keywords
keywords.description: A sentence that contains any of these (case-insensitive) is kept as a decision.

record_path.title: Decision log path
record_path.description: A successful Edit or Write whose file path contains this string clears the band.

max_items.title: Maximum kept decisions
max_items.description: Oldest decisions are dropped beyond this count.
